## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Identify any deliberately changed interaction or workflow rule.

## Compatibility

- [ ] Uses the existing Mantine theme, components and action/drawer conventions.
- [ ] Keeps intention, interest, assessment, progress and next action distinct and shared across pages.
- [ ] Preserves evidence, private/public boundaries, saved work and sent snapshots.
- [ ] Updates the current documentation in place, or explains why no update is needed.

## Validation

List commands run and results. Mark non-applicable checks with a reason.

- [ ] Tests and production build pass (or documentation-only exception explained).
- [ ] Relevant workflow, refresh and migration paths checked.
- [ ] UI changes include desktop/mobile and affected open/closed state screenshots.
- [ ] Keyboard, Escape and restored focus checked for affected interactions.

Include limitations or remaining review points. Screenshots must use isolated sample data.
